observations: Most Popular was calmer than yesterday: three games entered (Wash the Car, RUNAWAYS, MVSD) and two left (Dogs of War, Smash the City).
Steal An Egg (84 days) still leads, ahead of Brookhaven, Murder Mystery 2, +1 Speed Keyboard Escape, 99 Nights in the Forest and RIVALS.

DIVINE HATCHERS (16 days) made the biggest climb (+37), followed by Facecard: Makeup Showdown and Peel THE Potato (+12 each), while young egg games (Drill for Eggs -16, Steal An EXE Egg -9) and COCARDO (-16) fell.
Multi-year games keep the best median standing (percentile 61) against 33 to 44 for every younger band, so the mid-life trough idea stays at low confidence.
patterns: Higher dev product and pass prices tend to go with longer Most Popular stays (splits near 199 R$ and 69 R$), with age as a confounder because older games price higher.
Games left more than a week without an update stay fewer days on the chart (r=-0.46 at the 7-day split), a new threshold test.
Combat PvP (median percentile 74), story adventure and simulation-job loops hold the best standing, while idle-tycoon, wave-survival, obby and steal-and-defend loops sit near the bottom.
More complex games tend to stay longer (rho +0.26); the video set still shows two durable looks, near-empty HUD social worlds and dense progression or match HUDs.

outliers.name: Steal An Egg
outliers.note: Leads with a steal-and-defend loop whose clones rank near the bottom, consistent with being the original of the wave.

outliers.name: DIVINE HATCHERS 0.0001% [NEW!]

observations: Donation hubs (Summer Donations, Donation Central, Simple DONATIONS) again lead efficiency, followed by The Company, Elemental Dungeons and Morioh High.
Young survival and horror titles (Bunker vs Verity, Sarab, Sell Fries!) plus Chop A Forest are the least efficient for their player counts.
Older games made the biggest climbs (Emergency Emden +104, Swordburst 2 +84, MORPH WORLD +73), while young '+1' titles fell hardest (+1 Mog Evolution -91, +1 DMG FPS -63).
15-to-42-day games have the lowest median efficiency (22) and games past a year sit near 59, consistent with revenue catching up with age.
patterns: Dev products above about 249 R$, servers of 25+ players, longer descriptions, bracket tags and higher pass prices consistently go with better efficiency, though many of these also mark older, actively run games.
RPGs, roleplay and combat PvP loops consistently earn more for their CCU; roleplay/social loops (r=+0.30) are now tested on their own, separate from the donation-hub genre idea.
Survival, pet/egg, steal-a-X and '+1' games consistently earn less, and 'Egg' and 'Steal' title words carry the strongest negative keyword links (r=-0.53 and -0.43).
Video observations from long-running PvP hits keep pointing to cosmetics and paid roles as the visible monetization, which stays speculative.

outliers.name: Morioh High
outliers.note: Among the most efficient at 15 days with one pass and six products, against the age effect; a small CCU makes this unreliable.

outliers.name: Emergency Emden
outliers.note: Climbed 104 places at 1,320 days, likely an update or weekend spike in a roleplay game rather than a structural change.

observations: Cat Battles (12 days) led momentum, ahead of Wash the Car, Build a Keyboard (+29), صيد الضبّان, Facecard: Makeup Showdown and RoFront.
The chart turned over heavily: 23 entries and 22 exits, with many older games (Forsaken, Evade, Squid Game X, Tower Defense Simulator) re-entering on Halloween updates.
The youngest band (0-14 days) holds a median momentum percentile of 94, far above 15-to-84-day games (51) and 85-to-122-day games (16).
Young '+1' escape games (+1 Hair Escape, +1 Web Escape, +1 Lift Rock for Treasure) are the weakest on momentum, and Swim For Eggs fell 33.
patterns: Young games selling spins or crates may climb faster (r=+0.43, within-age +0.51), a new test; age is a confounder because the youngest games dominate the band.
'+1' titles may climb more slowly (r=-0.49 on 8 games), now tested separately from the Top Earning '+1' idea.
Luck products, escape/flee loops and creature themes tend to go with weaker momentum, while currency packs and building loops tend to go with stronger momentum.
Many re-entries carry a Halloween bracket tag, so the seasonal event is a confounder for this week's turnover.

outliers.name: Cat Battles 🐾
outliers.note: Led momentum with a creature-themed PvP loop and 152 dev products, against both the PvP and creature-theme ideas.

outliers.name: Wash the Car 🧽
outliers.note: A 62-day solo idle game with no passes still ranks second on momentum and entered Most Popular, against the solo-loop and age ideas.

observations: Chop A Forest and Sell Fries! (both 26 days) lead Up-and-Coming, ahead of Climb For Animals Eggs, Facecard: Makeup Showdown, Sarab and WRONG WAY!.
Cat Battles (+36) and Bike For Egg (+26) made the biggest climbs, while Draw a Dumpling (-21), Army Commander Tycoon (-20) and Pogo For Animals (-18) fell.
Eight games entered, including licensed Save the Krusty Krab, the Arabic story game Where Is Fahd? (2 days) and Eat Everything In A Grocery Store.
The 15-to-42-day band holds the best median standing (54), slightly above the 0-14-day band (47).
patterns: Recently and frequently updated games consistently rank higher among games of the same age (days since update rho -0.34, updates per week +0.32).
Core competitive loops (r=+0.46) and revive products tend to go with higher positions, and asking players to favorite the game tends to help (within-age +0.41).
Shorter titles may rank higher (split at 23 characters, r=-0.41), a new test.
Steal-and-defend (median 22) and idle-tycoon (23) loops sit lowest, while hatch-pet (84) and collect-upgrade-rebirth (76) loops sit highest.

outliers.name: Deliver The Baby 🍼
outliers.note: Weakest on the chart with a 45% like ratio and no update in 18 days, consistent with the update and like-ratio ideas.

outliers.name: Where Is Fahd?
outliers.note: Entered at 2 days with no dev products and a 73% like ratio, carried by an Arabic-language story audience.

summary: Visits and favorites lead associations on Most Popular, Top Trending and Up-and-Coming, but they are partly outcomes of success rather than causes.
Higher product and pass prices go with both longer Most Popular stays and better Top Earning efficiency, while complexity helps both, so depth and pricing travel together.
Steal and egg templates keep reaching the breakout charts while their young clones fall on several charts at once and earn poorly, supporting the fading-wave idea.
Regional-language games (Arabic, Filipino, Middle-East car culture) appear across Top Trending and Up-and-Coming entries, a new speculative pattern.
progressions: Top Trending to Most Popular remains the most common sequence (60 entries, median 2 days later).
Up-and-Coming to Top Trending follows (54, median 2 days), then Top Earning to Top Trending (41, 5 days) and Up-and-Coming to Most Popular (36, 4 days).
